name: peak_plate_powder
prompt:
Redraw the reference scene exactly - the same mountain summit, hut, trail sign, pines, flag, cairn, peaks and valley, all in the same places, the same framing and camera (do not zoom in), the same empty snow patch on the right, the same cartoon style - but change the mood: FRESH POWDER: a soft pink-and-lavender sky, heavy fluffy snow falling, extra-deep fresh powder piled high on every roof, rock, tree and sign, sparkling snow crystals in the air. No people, no characters, no text. Higher quality and a little more detailed than before: crisp clean ink lines, more small texture lines in the snow, rock and wood, more depth layers - but still flat cartoon colours, readable at a glance.

Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
